notes.title: Perfect World Is an Honorable Mention at the Independent Games Festival!
notes.notes: Thank you to the Independent Games Festival for selecting Perfect World as an Honorable Mention in the Best Student Game category. I'm glad the message resonated!

notes.title: Perfect World Selected as an A+D Museum Design Awards Winner
notes.notes: Perfect World has been selected as the winner of the 2024 A+D Museum Design Awards in the Realtime & Interactive category! The museum, located in Los Angeles, will host an exhibition called MACHINA DA24 (Interlude) of all winning works from August 9, 2024 to September 28, 2024. The opening night of the exhibition is Friday, August 9, from 7-9pm. Come play the game on an array of CRT TVs and enjoy the other exemplary works!
